newsitem.title: USA: Cardon refinery seen fully up by later this week.
newsitem.headline: Cardon refinery seen fully up by later this week.

text.p: Maraven's Cardon refinery in northwest Venezuela, which experienced a full power outage Sunday night, will be fully operational by Wednesday or Thursday, a company official said Monday.
The 305,000 barrels per day (bpd) plant went down for four hours when generators supplying it were hit by an electrical storm.
Maraven is an operating unit of state Petroleos de Venezuela.

"It's a sequential process. Everything should be at maximum stream by Wednesday or Thursday," the official said. Earlier Monday, Maraven said it expected the plant to be fully back on stream by the end of the day.
However, the official said that Maraven conducted an analysis of customers and inventories and concluded that "so far nobody will be affected. We expect to meet our May refining target."

The plant is one of the largest in Latin America and supplies gasoline and other products to both the U.S. and Latin American markets. It experienced problems in April which led to cancellation of some gasoline cargoes.
